contract.name: All market rates WEF 01 Feb 2026 (Winter/Summer 2026 – Winter 2026/27) – Full Villa (5 rooms)
contract.tax_note: All room rates inclusive of all taxes; non-commissionable
contract.voucher_note: Reservation voucher MUST state the quoted room rate (basis) and other necessary information such as supplements
contract.terms_text: All room rates are inclusive of all taxes and non-commissionable. Contracted rates are confidential and cannot be published online or on any platform other than the company system. Check-in 2.00 pm, check-out 11.00 am; early check-in / late check-out subject to availability, charges apply. No pets. Bookings are confirmed by e-mail, subject to written confirmation from the reservations department followed by a proforma invoice. If overbooked, the hotel may transfer reservations to alternate accommodation of similar rating/category. Guests are responsible for any loss or damage to hotel property. DBI e-mail 24 Aug 2026: rates apply to new reservations only; only HB bookings are accepted on 24 and 31 Dec 2026; reservations / amendments / cancellations to info@dbihotels.lk, reservation@dbihotels.lk, sales3@dbihotels.lk.
contract.child_policy_text: Below 5.99 years free of charge sharing parent's bed on booked basis. 6 – 11 years 50% of the adult rate on booked basis per night (excluding extra bed). 12 years and above considered as an adult. Extra bed $15 per night. Child meal rate 50% of the adult rate.
contract.cancellation_text: November – April: release period 21 days prior to arrival; 50% of the full booking value charged if cancelled within 21 days. May – October: release period 14 days prior to arrival; 50% of the full booking value charged if cancelled within 14 days. No-shows: 100% of the full stay / no refund (if payment is settled). An early departure fee applies for cancellations made after check-in.
contract.payment_text: Full payment to be settled 7 days prior to the date of arrival. Cheque payments must be banked and realised at least 10 days prior to arrival. Reservations made within 7 days of arrival: payment in full upon booking confirmation. Failure to settle in full by the above date: rooms released without prior notice. Hotel reserves the right to release bookings with unsettled payment (excluding credit agents) with advance notice of 14 days or more. Bank: DBI Ceylon (Pvt) Ltd, Commercial Bank Rajagiriya, A/C 1000580196. Quote travel agency / guest name / confirmation number as reference.
contract.notes: Whole-villa price per night (RO / BB / HB) for the 5-room villa; the sheet does not print the villa pax capacity. No gala supplement printed.
